## Reaching

**Artwork by @samdape, used with permission. All rights stay with the artist.** The hands are
@samdape's dot rendering of the hands in Michelangelo's *Creation of Adam*. The fresco itself is
public domain; this permission is about @samdape's rendering. In this repository the artwork is:
`themes/reaching/reference-dots.json` (every dot, measured from the artwork),
`plugins/*/hooks/scene-reaching*.js`, `cards/reaching.svg` and `assets/live/reaching.svg`.
For any use beyond the above, ask @samdape.

On windows wider than a laptop the forearms carry on past the artwork's left and right edges. That
part is **not** @samdape's: it is our extension, traced from the public-domain fresco in the same
dots (`themes/reaching/fresco-arms.json`, made by `themes/reaching/trace-arms.py`).

## Magenta Hour and After Hours

Original artwork and original music (three tracks synthesised in code by
`themes/magenta-hour/make-music.py`, nothing sampled), © 2026 neverblinks. Files:
`plugins/*/hooks/scene-magenta-hour.js`, `scene-after-hours.js`, `cards/magenta-hour.svg`,
`cards/after-hours.svg`, `plugins/*/music/` and `assets/live/magenta-hour.svg`, `assets/live/after-hours.svg`.

## Fractal Glass

Drawn in code by neverblinks after a free Unsplash photo by universtock. Files:
`plugins/*/hooks/scene-fractal-glass.js`, `cards/fractal-glass.svg` and `assets/live/fractal-glass.svg`.

## Ember

A warm glow in the corner of a dark, grainy screen, © 2026 neverblinks. Files:
`plugins/*/hooks/scene-ember.js`, `cards/ember.svg` and `assets/live/ember.svg`.

## Crossing Hour, Promenade, Coast Road and Ocean Road

Drawn in code by neverblinks, © 2026: Tower Bridge, the Brooklyn Bridge, Bixby Creek Bridge and the
Atlantic Ocean Road's Storseisundet bridge, each drawn from the bridge's real structure with original
compositions, palettes and motion. No photograph is traced, included or redistributed. Files: `plugins/*/hooks/scene-crossing-hour.js`,
`scene-promenade.js`, `scene-coast-road.js`, `scene-ocean-road.js`, `cards/crossing-hour.svg`,
`cards/promenade.svg`, `cards/coast-road.svg`, `cards/ocean-road.svg` and `assets/live/crossing-hour.svg`,
`promenade.svg`, `coast-road.svg`, `ocean-road.svg`.
